correctness.rationale: In flag coordinates (u,v,w), the four vanishing coefficients in F(u,v,0) and the nonzero u³w coefficient exactly express order-four tangency at a smooth point when F has no line component, which is automatic for a geometrically smooth projective quartic. Allowing a zero v⁴ coefficient before geometric screening is harmless. The independent replay /tmp/opencode/quartic_review.py fixes u³w=1 in the flag basis, enumerates the other ten free ternary coordinates for each of 52 flags, then transforms back and normalizes. It reproduced every positive flag count in the frozen table, with 9,997 forms having ≥5 flags and none rationally nonsingular. Of the 87,750 four-flag forms, 52,884 have no rational Jacobian zero. Euler's identity applies because 4=1 in F3. Generator closure on that candidate set gives 18 orbits; chart-wise Jacobian Gröbner bases leave exactly three geometrically smooth orbits, matching the literal F_A,F_B,F_C in sizes 1872,234,234. Thus stabilizer orders are 5616 divided by the respective sizes, and 2,340 equations attain equality. Independent substitution at rational points gave point counts 5,4,4 and hyperflex sets on Y=0 for A, on X=Y for C, and with all triple determinants nonzero for B. The no-rational-singularity test alone was used only to discard candidates, not to certify geometric smoothness. Frozen programs were inspected but not executed.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A line with divisor 4P has singleton geometric support; if the line and curve are rational, that support is Frobenius-fixed. Conversely a rational hyperflex has a rational tangent and a smooth point has only one tangent. Thus the apparently different observables are equivalent.
